verdict.rationale: A test or sandbox environment that is separate from production (test-mode keys, an isolated staging account) is a fair question for a hosted API service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such environment. 'Browser Sandbox' refers to managed interactive browser sessions, not isolation from production data. The webhook testing doc only covers exposing a local server, and API key scoping is an adjacent access control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
